name: Shadow

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.summary: Can pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
traits.text: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch, and doing so costs it no extra movement.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.summary: Has Disadvantage on D20 Tests while in sunlight.
traits.text: While the shadow is in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Draining Swipe
actions.summary: Necrotic touch that lowers the target's Strength by 1d4; at 0 Strength the target dies.
actions.text: Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. If this brings the score to 0, the target dies. A Humanoid killed by this attack rises as a new Shadow 1d4 hours later.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.
bonus_actions.text: If the shadow is in Dim Light or Darkness, it can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

summary: Hides in darkness, slips through cracks and drains Strength; weak to radiant damage and sunlight.
